description: Foreign Direct Investment in Data Centers Is BoomingThe global surge in foreign direct investments is increasingly focused on digital infrastructure. In 2025, data centers recorded the biggest growth by far among FDI-related investments – an increase of $235 billion in 2025 compared to 2024. They therefore significantly outperformed all other sectors. Look at the United States we have closed to 5500 data centers. We are being taken over by forgien investors.
